# GitHub Copilot instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root: it is the canonical instruction file for every coding
agent in this repository (spec-driven development, gates G0-G7 approved by people, clean
architecture, Poetry, English, documentation as part of every change).

Phase skills are in `.agents/skills/` and as prompt files in `.github/prompts/` (generated by
`poetry run sdd sync`). Never run `sdd approve` and never edit `approvals:` in a `dossier.yaml`.
